critical_code_review_comments: Fix on HomePage.js line 482 (CoverMosaic) and line 315 (ResultRow) and KoalaStudio.js line 576 is correct and consistent with the iteration_28 GamerTracksPage pattern: `key={`${track_id||'x'}-${year ?? '_'}-${rank ?? idx}`}`. This composite key properly disambiguates cross-collection / cross-year duplicates (f6bf37ecb304a4 Smells Like Teen Spirit and c973892848d835 Black/Pearl Jam) that legitimately appear in both Hottest 100 and Top 200 Hip-Hop merged catalog.

All three React key sites for the merged catalog are now consistent — fallback chain track_id||'x', year ?? '_', rank ?? idx — which is a good DRY pattern. Consider extracting to a tiny util (e.g., `catalogRowKey(t, idx)`) if more sites appear in future.
